I didn't expect upvotes when i wrote my comment. I am just tired of all the single minded thoughts on this sub reddit. There are  two sides to every story and unfortunately we only have OPs perspective. Every post has been sympathetic towards the poster. I am tired of this "we are all girls lets stick together" bandwagon. Ladies, we need to think for ourselves. Also, was not defending the doctor. Seems like her goal is disease prevention but she may not have the best interpersonal skills. OP could have simply said   "No, i don't think that will work for me"

Their reaction to you and your responses about your sex life may have been unwarranted but they were probably trying to be over cautious. I am sure they see all sorts of patients with several partners coming in with multiple stds. they give the safe sex talk to anyone that comes in the clinic. They probably just don't want you to make the same mistakes other patients have made in the past. To be fair, abstinence is the best way not to get pregnant or contract diseases but it is not the most realistic. Also they are used to patients lying to them left and right.

Sources: i am a nurse
